TokenBudgetBasis.node_purpose: Deterministically recompile immutable R11 retrieval output under R12 route, clause, governing-price-head, connector-proof and persistence/projection contracts; there is no model node and no paid-call authority.
TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Five frozen requests, six DELL targets, immutable R11 raw output with 338 unique union objects and 80 final objects, and a bound corpus of 1,888 source records plus 34,199 compiled objects.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: One exact R11-raw reuse capture, one private result, one reader-safe public projection, six target-level route/transformation receipts, and byte-exact saved-formal replay evidence.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: ClauseOwnershipDecision v3, GoverningPriceHeadProof v2, predicate frame v8, connector-proof transformation v4, constant 03A-R2 route identities, exact input lineage, exact-once receipts and private/public allowlists.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: A false accept could promote fabricated Dell ASP, units, capacity, yield or supplier evidence; a false route erasure could suppress required source work; a projection mismatch could hide failed transformation evidence.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Immutable R11 formal/replay raw SHA 0e9e4456ba75ecd07bc2e3bd6d5deddafc1972ba19700b029b2e6793e99f7458, fresh R11 audit 0/1/3/0, and R12 full-corpus preview digest ad4ef78ca6226ceb749d50649419ba25ca90b8d88d50060d55982cbc48297b4a in 23.882675 seconds.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Pure deterministic Python validation and compilation with zero generated tokens, zero local embedding batches, zero provider/network/model calls and exact reuse of the already frozen R11 candidate ranks.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before attempt consumption on Git, policy, implementation, input, disk, R17-bundle or raw-lineage drift. After exclusive receipt creation, preserve any failure as terminal same-attempt evidence; no retry, fallback, silent truncation or alternate output path.
